findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following nonfood-contact surfaces in need of cleaning:
(i) the undersides of the soda dispensers.
(ii) the bottom of the short cooler.
The PIC was informed and will have staff clean these areas more frequently to prevent an accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]
